title: Naturalist reacts: a king cobra eating a python
storyboard: Film: naturalist in corner inset reacting, holding a shed snake skin as a prop, 2 takes

scenes.headline: Normal for a king cobra
scenes.body: It eats mostly other snakes: rat snakes, dhamans, even pythons up to about 3 m.

scenes.headline: And it builds a nest
scenes.body: The female piles leaves into a mound; heat from decomposition incubates the eggs.

scenes.label: Max length of a king cobra

caption:
The snake that eats snakes.

Some king cobras stick to a single prey species of snake and refuse anything else. The python photo is from Kaeng Krachan National Park, Thailand.

Source: Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Reaction demo on a still photo: the naturalist's explanations carry the reel, inset is a placeholder for the real reactor.
